title: Add live RAG authoring playground with schema linter and telemetry adapters
author: Sofia Patel
description:
Motivation: ship a compact, local-first RAG authoring playground that helps engineers iterate on tool contracts, prompt templates, and telemetry without spinning up the whole stack. This PR introduces a single-page dev playground that validates tool schemas in real time, offers structured-output linting, and wires lightweight telemetry adapters so teams can preview Redwood Console events locally.

What this adds: 1) a new web-based playground (playgrounds/authoring-live) with hot reload and an embedded schema-linter for tool/contract JSON and OpenAPI snippets; 2) an examples directory with two adapter templates (examples/playground-adapters) that show how to forward telemetry events to Redwood Console or to a local debug sink; 3) docs and a short quickstart (docs/authoring-playgrounds.md) with setup steps and recommended prompt sets for regression testing; 4) CI workflow (ci/workflows/rag-playground-e2e.yaml) that runs smoke e2e and contract lint on push to main.

Checklist: - [x] Implement live authoring UI and schema linter - [x] Add telemetry adapter examples and config presets - [x] Add quickstart docs and local run instructions - [x] Add CI smoke test and headless e2e - [x] Address accessibility and minimal UX polish requested by reviewers

Local dev notes: yarn install && yarn --cwd playgrounds/authoring-live dev (starts dev server on :5173 with hot reload). To run contract lint locally: yarn --cwd playgrounds/authoring-live lint:contracts. To run the e2e smoke locally (headless): ./ci/scripts/run_playground_smoke.sh --headless.

Compatibility: playground is explicitly optional for customers; it uses the existing SDK bindings and sandbox tokens. No backend changes to runtime are required. Telemetry adapter shows how to tag events with route_id and prompt_variant so Console can group quickstart runs.

Related: builds on ENG-1297 (authoring UX improvements) and PM-452 (quickstart backlog).

review_comments: Ari Chen: Nice end-to-end idea. Please extract CSS vars and reduce global scope to avoid collisions with user repos.
Sofia Patel: Good call — moved colors to --playground-* vars and scoped root styles to .rf-playground-root in the next commit.
Maya Singh: The schema linter is great; can we add a quick auto-fix suggestion for missing required fields? Also e2e seemed flaky on CI first run.
Sofia Patel: Added an auto-fix suggestion modal for common missing fields and tightened the e2e wait logic; re-ran CI.
Luca Rossi: Please make telemetry tag names snake_case to match Console expectations (route_id -> route_id, promptVariant -> prompt_variant).
Sofia Patel: Updated adapter presets and docs to recommend snake_case event tags.
ci_summary: Initial run: build: pass, lint: fail (style), e2e: flaky timeout on headless browser. After style fixes and e2e wait adjustments: build: pass, lint: pass, e2e: pass. Workflow: ci/workflows/rag-playground-e2e.yaml runs matrix across node 18/20 and runs contract-lint, unit, and headless smoke in that order.
merge_notes: Squashed and merged after CI green and reviewers approved. Kept individual commits in PR for traceability in the branch history; squash merged into a short single commit for main.
release_notes: Add a local-first RAG authoring playground with live schema linting and telemetry adapter examples. This is a developer-facing quickstart to help teams iterate on tool contracts and telemetry event shapes before deploying to Dedicated/Private environments.

impact_summary: Low-risk doc/quickstart addition that enables faster local iteration for engineers and reduces friction for integrating telemetry events. No production runtime changes.
